headline: V26-3775: show a plan on the live and hosted views while it is being planned, on the chapter-pages live view

V26-3776.title: Say "agent review only" and show decisions on a plan preview

criteria.text: A preview with no round renders "Agent review only · not reviewed yet · not approved by a person"; with three open rounds, "Agent review only · 3 review rounds · still open · not approved by a person"; aligned and ended use their endings; handed renders "Handed to delivery " and never "not approved by a person".

For every preview fixture, the plan chapter's text matches no /approv/ case-insensitively outside the approvals fold's title node and the approval item nodes, and has no switcher and no "Changes since approval" fold.
Every /approv/i string literal in run-summary.js has a preview wording in its table, apart from the named exact enum values it compares against and never displays ("approve").

The schema and validate_plan alike refuse an unknown preview field, delivery without handed, handed without delivery, a short commit, approval: "approved", layout: "x", a 601-character decision or plan, and 101 decisions.
Every existing delivery plan fixture validates and renders byte for byte unchanged, and the existing row pinning "Approved on round 3" for a delivery plan stays green.

V26-3777.title: Mark preview servers and list them on the runs page

criteria.text: With only a preview server running, live --if-absent starts a standing server instead of returning the preview's address; with both running, it returns the standing server's.
The runs page lists one row per verified preview with its local link and, when its preview.json names one, its hosted link.
An unreadable or oversized preview.json drops only that row's title and hosted link, never the row or the page.
With no preview, previews is absent from the view and the runs page and every golden are byte for byte unchanged.

V26-3778.title: Build a plan preview from a plan file and its review store

criteria.text: A delivery-layout plan gives one unit per story with its lane, after keys, and its Scenarios: and Done when items as criteria; finish lines, approvals, out-of-scope (heading or Out of scope: list) and decisions are read, and the result passes validate_plan.
outcome.summary equals the prefix plus the title, the record's headline equals it, and a 700-character title still gives at most 600 characters starting with the full prefix.
A plan with no ## Stories gives layout: other, no units, an empty planned, and still validates.
A rebuild with nothing changed writes and journals nothing; a rebuild after a new commit replaces plan.json and state.json and journals one plan.updated, with the folder's inode unchanged.
Nothing is written outside the preview folder.

V26-3779.title: Serve and publish the preview, unasked, from plan-review

criteria.text: With liveHome and hosted pointed at the test origin, plan-view --plan on a committed plan with no round prints both links; the local page shows stories by lane with criteria, the finish line, decisions, approvals, out-of-scope and "Agent review only · not reviewed yet · not approved by a person"; the origin holds a cut with the same preview member and an outcome.summary starting "Plan preview (agent review only): ".
After plan-review prepare and reduce, the local page and hosted cut show the round with the live server pid, hosted watcher pid and preview folder inode unchanged.
With neither liveHome nor hosted, the plan-review commands and plan-view print no preview line, build no record and start no process.

After lead-setup adopts the store of a running preview, the last hosted cut carries approval: handed with the store's rounds, both pids are gone, and lead-setup's output and exit code are as without a preview.
The standing server's runs page lists the running preview with its local and hosted links.

V26-3780.title: Make the preview the default posture in the workflows' docs

criteria.text: Each named doc states its part as above, in outcome language with no ticket or plan-unit identifiers.
Every corpus pin on the changed files is re-derived in the same change and stays green.
Catalog entries, every selected profile and provenance.lock.json digests are refreshed through scripts/update-provenance.py, and scripts/validate-registry.py passes.
The full local suite passes on macOS with Python 3.11 with --budget tests/suite-budget.json.

finish.label: The stories
finish.text: V26-3776, V26-3777, V26-3778, V26-3779 and V26-3780 land on integrate/plan-preview-views through its merge queue, each with every criterion met

finish.label: Preview end to end
finish.text: Finish lines 2, 3, 5, 6 and 7 of the plan hold in their fixture repositories at the integration head: plan-view prints both links, a review round reaches the local page and hosted cut with no restart, no preview without liveHome or hosted, the handed finish on adoption, and the runs page lists the preview

finish.label: Never reads as approved
finish.text: A preview's plan chapter page matches no /approv/ outside the approvals fold title and its items, for every preview fixture, and every delivery-written plan fixture renders byte for byte as before, on the chapter-pages line map

finish.label: Local suite
finish.text: The full local suite passes on macOS with Python 3.11 at the integration head, with --workers 4 --budget tests/suite-budget.json
